ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Tender and estimate, Opportunity and later stages need Procurement route and Work type.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Tender_estimate", CASE(StageName, "Opportunity", 1, "Go or no-go", 2, "Estimating", 3, "Bid submitted", 4, "Clarification", 5, "Preferred bidder", 6, "Awarded", 7, 0) >= 1, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Procurement_route__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Work_type__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Procurement route and Work type before moving to Opportunity.
